null_policy: Blank becomes NULL; zero stays zero; unavailable versus inapplicable remains unresolved when source does not distinguish them. Negative sentinels are preserved.
identity_policy: Roster key includes snapshot/game/patch/scale/subculture/unit. Shared unit relations use main-unit identity, never an arbitrary race row. Permissions do not transfer across aliases or rosters.

classification.core_passive: Automatic normal-combat mechanic, including conditional effects; inspect ability definition and casting.passive.
classification.activated_option: Deliberate ability or spell, including bound spells; retain qualified access and deferred reference only.
classification.unresolved: Absent or contradictory definition/casting evidence; never infer from name prefix or source_type alone.
classification.application: No changes to base stats. Interpretation and applicability belong to issues #5/#6.

operations: Preserve native add/mult/opaque tokens. A reviewed serving mapping may rename mult to multiply; no engine arithmetic is inferred.
provenance: Source file/hash plus 1-based logical CSV record index including header; separately preserve upstream physical source_line, source_path and source_patch. Never equate the two line conventions.

coverage_boundary.structural_validation: Pinned published upstream audit plus local hash/header/type/key/count and selected join checks. Not a rerun of the complete upstream extraction validators.
coverage_boundary.semantic_coverage: partial; preserve native unknowns and unresolved references
coverage_boundary.runtime_coverage: unverified; this step does not classify every ability, calculate effects or prove payload closure
coverage_boundary.raw_passthrough_fields: TEXT deliberately preserves extension tokens whose types are not established by the unit builder; reviewed native type refinement is required before numeric use.
coverage_boundary.next_step: Commit packet schema and source-backed/synthetic fixtures before implementing the importer.
